steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Xoolal say téere yu ñu leen di bàyyi ak bés yi ñu leen di bàyyi
steps.step10: Fàttaliku sa taariix bu jëkk ak doxalukaay yi
steps.step13: Jëfandikukat, email ak internet bu gratuit
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step23: Bindal ab waxtaan ci wàllu wér-gi-yaram
steps.step27: Jëfandikoo ci liggéeykat yu am ñaareelu xaalis
steps.step29: Jëfandikoo ab kont ci banke te def ab dencukaay
steps.step31: Jëfandikoo ak njaboot bi, te jëfe ndimbalug xale bi, su ko defee
steps.step33: Fàttaliku benn siblu bu yàgg te màggal sa 90 fan

phase3.groupsHelp: Jëfandikukat yi, jëfandikukat yi di leen dimbali ci delluwaat ci liggéey bi, ak jëfandikukat yi bokk ci diine yi ak mboolooy askan wi ci wàllug dëkk yi ak jamonoy ndaje yi.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Amul benn ku ànd ak moom ci ndaje mi, kon Needes a Ride dafay mel ni ku mujj.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Jëfandikukat yi am sañ-sañ rekk. Jëfandikukat yi dinañu dem benn ci benn ak diirub 2i waxtu; dangeen ko wóorlu bala ñu yónnee xët wu ci topp.
phase3.contactLabel: Tur wu ñu mën a wax
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.calcResult: ay weer ngir jot sa coppite
phase3.musicHelp: Jëfandikoo rekk ay coppite. Amul ay kont yuy jàll. Jëfandikoo bi dafay dëddu ci biir jàngukaay bi ak module yi.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Ba nga nekk ci module bi, muusig bi dañu koy tëj.
phase3.shareWho: Léegi: yaw rekk. Jëfandikoo ab lëkkalekaay moo tax képp ku am lëkkalekaay bi mën koo jàng.
phase3.mintLink: Xët wu nekk ci wii xët
